# the paths that run .github/workflows/unsafe-and-parallel.yml (scripts/changed_paths.py decide)
# on.pull_request.paths of the workflow, when it has one, must list the same patterns in
# the same order (scripts/changed_paths.py sync)
# every file a job of the workflow executes or reads is listed: a missing one skips the
# job on a change that alters it
# a path gate on purpose: Miri and loom take 45-95 min, so they run when the unsafe or
# parallel code they exercise changes, not on every change of src/ (scripts/ci_load_check.py
# fails when an unrelated src file would start them)
# the code under test: the batched / parallel solver and its submodules (solver::tests,
# loom_tests), the BVH and the contact cache (Miri), and the other files with raw-pointer
# or parallel paths
src/solver.rs
src/solver/**
src/solver_tgs*.rs
src/bvh.rs
src/contact_cache.rs
src/query.rs
src/laminate.rs
# compiled into the bvh module of the lib tests (#[path])
tests/lib/bvh_oracles.rs
# rayon / crossbeam / loom versions (Stacked Borrows reports depend on them) and the toolchain
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain.toml
# the changes and gate jobs
scripts/changed_paths.py
.github/workflows/unsafe-and-parallel.yml
.github/paths/unsafe-and-parallel.txt
